collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was collected

mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of IAM users with MFA enabled

root_mfa_enabled.description: Whether root/owner account has MFA enabled

root_access_protected.description: Whether the highest-privilege root or tenant-root access path is protected from password-only use by MFA or by absence of standing root credentials

access_key_rotation_compliant_pct.description: Percentage of access keys rotated within policy (typically 90 days)

encryption_pct.description: Percentage of storage resources with encryption at rest

public_access_blocked_pct.description: Percentage of storage resources with public access blocked

cloudtrail_enabled.description: Whether audit logging is enabled (CloudTrail/Cloud Audit Logs/Activity Log)

cloudtrail_multiregion.description: Whether audit logging covers all regions

ssh_open_to_world_pct.description: Percentage of security groups allowing SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0

rdp_open_to_world_pct.description: Percentage of security groups allowing RDP (port 3389) from 0.0.0.0/0

retention_days_min.description: Minimum backup retention period across all backup-enabled resources (days)

enabled.description: Whether vulnerability scanning is enabled (Inspector/Security Command Center/Defender)

unpatched_pct.description: Percentage of scanned resources with unpatched vulnerabilities
